title: Right-click pastes twice in the macOS terminal
symptom_summary: A single right-click inserts two copies of the selected text. The behavior appeared in 1.97.0 and stopped after reverting to 1.96.4.
repro_steps: Set terminal.integrated.rightClickBehavior to paste.
In the integrated terminal, select text and right-click to paste.

title: Terminal file links misread colons inside timestamped filenames
symptom_summary: Ctrl-clicking a timestamped relative path prints a no-results message. The terminal link removes leading zeroes from parts of the filename.
repro_steps: Create a log file whose timestamped name contains multiple colons.
Print the filename with a ./ prefix in the terminal.
Ctrl-click the printed path.

title: Terminal URL values contain escaped colons
symptom_summary: On Linux after the 1.100.0 update, URLs in terminal environment variables contain literal backslash-x3a sequences. Applications reject the resulting URLs.
repro_steps: Set an environment variable containing an HTTP URL in VS Code configuration.
Open the integrated terminal and inspect the variable with env.

title: Accepting a terminal completion leaves no separator before a flag
symptom_summary: Choosing the ls suggestion with Tab and immediately typing a flag concatenates the command and flag into ls-a.
repro_steps: Start a terminal with shell integration and terminal suggestions enabled.
Type ls and accept the first suggestion using Tab.
Type -a without entering a space.

title: Moving a terminal to a new window and back breaks Ctrl+Tab
symptom_summary: Ctrl+Tab stops cycling between files after a split pane is moved out and returned to the panel. Opening a file restores the shortcut.
repro_steps: Split the integrated terminal into two panes.
Move the second terminal to a separate window, then return it to the panel.
Press Ctrl+Tab in the editor or terminal.

title: Git Bash does not work when selected as the integrated terminal
symptom_summary: The reporter selects Git Bash and reports that it does not work. The text provides no exact error or launch behavior.
repro_steps: Select Git Bash from the terminal options.

title: New Windows terminals retain old environment variables
symptom_summary: After editing system or user environment variables, starting a terminal or reloading the window still uses old values. The report describes the same behavior with several shells.
shell: PowerShell, Command Prompt, and Git Bash
repro_steps: Change a Windows user or system environment variable while VS Code is open.
Open a new terminal or reload the VS Code window, then inspect the value.

title: Terminal commands fail around UNC paths
symptom_summary: The reporter describes trouble running code and sudden problems with UNC paths in the integrated terminal. The text omits a command, launch context and error.

title: tmux drag selection fails in a detached terminal window
symptom_summary: Dragging with the left mouse button selects normally in tmux in the main VS Code window. In a separate terminal window, selection fails and wheel scrolling still works.
repro_steps: Connect to remote Linux and run tmux with mouse handling on.
Verify drag selection in the main VS Code window.
Move the terminal to a new window and drag across text.

title: Terminal search stalls on the first characters with large scrollback
symptom_summary: After accumulating a large terminal buffer, typing the first few query characters into Ctrl+F makes the terminal and search box stall. Longer, more specific queries respond faster.
repro_steps: Increase integrated terminal scrollback to around 100,000 lines.
Fill the buffer with varied output.
Open terminal find and type a short query or delete characters.

title: Integrated terminal becomes very slow after an update
symptom_summary: The reporter notices a marked terminal slowdown after updating. The report does not identify the operation that is slow or how long it takes.

title: Running a script immediately crashes the integrated terminal
symptom_summary: The terminal crashes once a script starts. The report does not identify the script, shell, or error.
